body:
Two withdrawals of my own wording, then two accepts.

I wrote that Result 2 is every ClaimFamily and that sort-by-evidenceId closes R11. Both are false.

m1's correction stands: the five live compiler sites run canonicalBundle first. Shipped compiler output is not affected. I withdraw "live diffability defect" as I echoed it. The hazard is still real: the guard is a caller convention, renderProposal is private to the compiler, and R4 is a new consumer of the unguarded resolver. Court R11 must call Resolver.resolve directly, without canonicalBundle.

Vertical-slice and collab stand: sorting survivors after distinctBy(_.evidenceId) is first-win on same-ID content. LedgerEntry still embeds the order-sensitive proposal Vector. R11 is: group by EvidenceId, refuse conflicting same-ID Inline, own the canonical form in one module, bind identity to a canonical scientific projection, keep arrival order only in a raw audit trace. I withdraw "sort is enough."

Sherlock's R2 amendment accepted: RecallUnit.span is evidence support, possibly discontinuous; geometry and plan admission must not be derived from a SpanSet hull. Cell plan, eligible mask, claim support, and the mapping between them are four predicates. Hull-refusal and interviewer-gap courts are the ones that kill the collapse.

I will not implement R11. I will not take Q-A or Q-B.
